description: Add a message to an existing status page incident and set its status; RESOLVED closes it. It is public and emails the page's confirmed subscribers: confirm the wording with the user before calling. Every confirmed subscriber gets the update, except that resolving an incident they were never told about stays silent. To open a new incident use create_status_page_incident; to fix only the title, silently, use update_status_page_incident. Requires a key with the write scope. A resolved incident accepts only further RESOLVED updates; any other status is a 409. Returns the incident. Example: {"page_id": "<id from list_status_pages>", "incident_id": "<id from list_status_page_incidents>", "status": "RESOLVED", "body": "Fixed; error rates are back to normal."}

body.description: The message subscribers read, 1 to 5000 characters.

incident_id.description: The status page incident's uuid from list_status_page_incidents (not from list_incidents). An unknown id is a 404.

page_id.description: The status page's uuid from list_status_pages. An id that is not a status page of this organization is a 404.

status.description: INVESTIGATING, IDENTIFIED, MONITORING or RESOLVED; RESOLVED closes the incident on the page.
